sharedImprovements.finding: All 7 business pages lack skip-link; all 78 tool pages have it. Add skip-link to business pages for consistency and WCAG 2.4.1 compliance.

Business pages use a different, older page architecture (IFFE scripts, raw HTML forms, inline event wiring) vs the shared ToolKit mount pattern used by all 78 tools. Consider migrating business pages to the shared architecture for maintainability.

assets/catalog.js has 78 tools but repository docs claim 107 (114 total). 29 tools are missing from the catalogue. Investigate whether these tools were removed or the catalogue was never updated. This is a documentation/data integrity issue, not a code defect.

Business page script src names do not match slugs: margin-calculator.html loads margin.js, break-even-calculator.html loads break-even.js, late-payment-calculator.html loads late-fee.js. This is confusing and error-prone. Align script filenames with page slugs.
pdfpage-counter.js does not use guard() for its async pdf-lib operations, unlike merge-pdf.js which does. Standardize error handling across all tools that use async operations.
